measures.name: eligible_sessions
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true THEN session_id END)

measures.name: converted_sessions_base
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true AND order__order_status = 'paid' THEN orders.session_id END)

measures.name: paid_revenue_base
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true AND order__order_status = 'paid' THEN orders.amount_eur END)

measures.name: paid_order_count_base
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true AND order__order_status = 'paid' THEN orders.order_id END)

measures.name: conversion_rate
measures.expr: (COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true AND order__order_status = 'paid' THEN orders.session_id END), 0) + 0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true THEN session_id END)) / (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true THEN session_id END))

measures.name: average_paid_order_value
measures.expr: (SUM(CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true AND order__order_status = 'paid' THEN orders.amount_eur END) + 0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true THEN session_id END)) / (COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true AND order__order_status = 'paid' THEN orders.order_id END), 0) + 0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true THEN session_id END))

measures.name: converted_sessions
measures.expr: COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true AND order__order_status = 'paid' THEN orders.session_id END), 0) + 0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true THEN session_id END)

measures.name: paid_revenue
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true AND order__order_status = 'paid' THEN orders.amount_eur END) + 0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true THEN session_id END)

measures.name: paid_order_count
measures.expr: COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true AND order__order_status = 'paid' THEN orders.order_id END), 0) + 0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session__is_eligible = true THEN session_id END)
